boatApiKey.title: Boat API Key
boatApiKey.description: Boat API Key from noforeignland.com. Can be found in Account > Settings > Boat tracking > API Key.

minMove.title: Minimum boat move to log in meters
minMove.description: To keep file sizes small we only log positions if a move larger than this size (if set to 0 will log every move)

minSpeed.title: Minimum boat speed to log in knots
minSpeed.description: To keep file sizes small we only log positions if boat speed goes above this value to minimize recording position on anchor or mooring (if set to 0 will log every move)

sendWhileMoving.title: Attempt sending location while moving
sendWhileMoving.description: Should the plugin attempt to send tracking data to NFL while detecting the vessel is moving or only when stopped?

ping_api_every_24h.title: Force a send every 24 hours
ping_api_every_24h.description: Keeps your boat active on NFL in your current location even if you do not move

filterSource.title: Position source device
filterSource.description: EMPTY DEFAULT IS FINE - Set this value to the name of a source if you want to only use the position given by that source.

maxVelocity.title: Maximum velocity (m/s)
maxVelocity.description: Reject positions implying faster movement than this (catches GPS outliers). Default: 50 m/s ≈ 97 knots.

trackDir.title: Directory to cache tracks
trackDir.description:
EMPTY DEFAULT IS FINE - Path to store track data. Relative paths are stored in plugin data directory. Absolute paths can point anywhere.
Default: nfl-track

keepFiles.title: Keep track files on disk
keepFiles.description: If you have a lot of hard drive space you can keep the track files for logging purposes.

trackFrequency.title: Position tracking frequency in seconds
trackFrequency.description: To keep file sizes small we only log positions once in a while (unless you set this value to 0)

apiCron.title: Send attempt CRON
apiCron.description:
We send the tracking data to NFL once in a while, you can set the schedule with this setting.
CRON format: https://crontab.guru/

apiTimeout.title: API request timeout in seconds
apiTimeout.description: Timeout for sending data to NFL API. Increase for slow connections.
